kebab_example: aliyun iotcc create-iot-cloud-connector --isp mobile --apn CMWAP --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIoTCloudConnector

parameters.help_en:
The carrier of the cloud connector instance. Valid values:
telecom: China Telecom.
mobile: China Mobile.
unicom: China Unicom
parameters.help_zh:
指定云连接器实例的运营商。取值：
telecom：中国电信。
mobile：中国移动。
unicom：中国联通
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud connector instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cloud connector instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, start with a letter or Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但开头不能为`http://` 或`https://`
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the wildcard domain name feature.
true (Default Value): Enabled.
false: Shutdown.

The wildcard domain name feature is enabled by default. The value passed in this field is invalid
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启泛域名功能。
true（默认值）：开启。
false：关闭。

泛域名默认开启，本字段传值无效
parameters.name: wildcard_domain_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Client token used to ensure the idempotence of the Request.

Generate a parameter value from your client and ensure that this value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API Request as the ClientToken identity. The RequestId may differ for each API Request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for this request. Valid values:
true: Sends a validation request without creating an instance. The validation checks include whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If validation fails, the corresponding error is returned. If validation passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (Default Value): Sends a normal request. After passing validation, the instance is created immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The Region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can obtain the Region ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance user
parameters.name: resource_uid

parameters.help_en:
The version of the cloud connector instance. Different versions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition.

Standard: Standard Edition.

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today).</props>

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>

<props="intl">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)申请</props>
parameters.name: type
